text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our second summer camp has come to a
close.
Before we return to the academy,
I find Fine
Motion staring intently at the
grounds.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's quite all right! I just thought I'd like
to etch
this sight into my mind.
choice_data_list: 思い残したことがあるなら付き合うぞ
思い残したことがあるなら付き合うよ
choice_data_list_en: If there's anything left you wanted to do, I'll see it through with you.
If there's anything left you wanted to do, I'll tag along.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I never want to forget everything that
happened
here and the things I
learned... and the salty
flavor of the
beach house's ramen...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list_en: ...Want to grab a bite at the end?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My final bowl of camp ramen! Let's go at
once!
